# TransformMatchingTex

Qualified name: `manim.animation.transform\_matching\_parts.TransformMatchingTex`

class TransformMatchingTex(*mobject=None*, *\*args*, *use\_override=True*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`TransformMatchingAbstractBase`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase.html#manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase "manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase")

    A transformation trying to transform rendered LaTeX strings.

    Two submobjects match if their `tex_string` matches.

    See also

    [`TransformMatchingAbstractBase`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase.html#manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase "manim.animation.transform_matching_parts.TransformMatchingAbstractBase")

    Examples

    Example: MatchingEquationParts

    [Video example](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/MatchingEquationParts-1.mp4)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class MatchingEquationParts(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            variables = VGroup(MathTex("a"), MathTex("b"), MathTex("c")).arrange_submobjects().shift(UP)

            eq1 = MathTex("{{x}}^2", "+", "{{y}}^2", "=", "{{z}}^2")
            eq2 = MathTex("{{a}}^2", "+", "{{b}}^2", "=", "{{c}}^2")
            eq3 = MathTex("{{a}}^2", "=", "{{c}}^2", "-", "{{b}}^2")

            self.add(eq1)
            self.wait(0.5)
            self.play(TransformMatchingTex(Group(eq1, variables), eq2))
            self.wait(0.5)
            self.play(TransformMatchingTex(eq2, eq3))
            self.wait(0.5)
    ```
